title: Foreshadow Toolbox Center
heading: Official toolboxes and software updates. Modules follow Foreshadow contracts; changes take effect after restart.
name: Toolbox
cancelling: Cancelling… An installation transaction already in progress will finish safely.
active_tasks: Finish or stop monitoring, recording, export and research tasks before applying this change. The download remains cached.
choose: Select a toolbox to view its compatibility, dependencies and release notes.
cache_cleared: Download cache cleared. Installed versions were preserved.
restart_notice: Runtime modules are changed at process startup. Installation status can differ from the version currently loaded.
installed_restart: Change saved. Restart Foreshadow to activate it; the running session has not been replaced.
confirm_uninstall: Uninstall {name}? A preinstalled version, if present, will be restored after restart.
updates_available: {count} updates available. Open the Toolbox Center to review them.
error.signature: Official catalog signature verification failed. No changes were applied.
error.catalog_rollback: This catalog is older than the last trusted catalog, or reuses its sequence for different content.
error.platform: No compatible build for this system. Required build: {platform}.
error.application: Incompatible with Foreshadow {version}. Update Foreshadow or choose a compatible toolbox.
error.dependency: A required toolbox dependency is absent or incompatible.
error.hash: Package size or SHA-256 verification failed. The installed version was preserved.
error.busy: Another installation transaction is active. Try again after it finishes.
error.archive: The package archive is incomplete or invalid.
error.path: The package contains an unsafe or unsupported file path or link.
error.expanded_size: The expanded package exceeds its signed size limit.
error.storage: Could not safely write installation files or state.
error.file: An installation file is missing, unreadable or too large.
error.manifest: Package identity or metadata differs from the signed catalog.
error.components: A module failed structural or startup checks. {detail}
error.registry: The installation registry is invalid. Existing application files were preserved.
error.home: A writable user installation directory could not be located.
error.package_type: This Foreshadow version does not support the requested toolbox type.
error.not_newer: This version is already installed or is older. Use Restore previous version for rollback.
error.no_previous: No retained previous version is available.
error.duplicate_component: Two enabled toolboxes declare the same module.
error.bundled: This component is preinstalled. Manage its supported options or update it with Foreshadow.
error.space: Not enough free disk space for a verified, recoverable installation. Clear the download cache or free disk space.
error.cancelled: Operation cancelled. The active installation was preserved.
error.https: The official download requires a valid HTTPS URL.
error.download_size: The download exceeded its declared size limit.
error.timeout: The operation timed out. Check the connection and retry.
error.network: The official server could not be reached. {detail}
error.offline_catalog: This package is not in the trusted catalog. Place its signed catalog.json next to it, or check the official catalog first.
error.active_tasks: Finish or stop the current monitoring, recording, export and research tasks before installation.
error.activation: Could not start the update helper. The running application was preserved.
error.action: This operation is not supported by this toolbox.
